nodes.label: docs workflow (Astro Starlight to GitHub Pages)
nodes.rationale: Builds and deploys on pushes to main, which only moves when a release is cut, so published docs track released versions. The release: [published] trigger is deliberately not used — its runs execute on the TAG ref and are rejected by the github-pages environment protection rules, which is how the v0.11.0 docs deploy failed.

nodes.label: docs build job
nodes.rationale: Full-history checkout because Starlight's lastUpdated reads Git history — a shallow checkout makes every page report 'now'. Root dependencies install first so TypeDoc can resolve src/ imports, and Playwright Chromium is fetched separately for Mermaid SSR.

nodes.label: docs deploy job
nodes.rationale: pages: write and id-token: write live in this job rather than at workflow level, so only a one-step job with no checkout and no dependencies can mint the deploy credential; contents: read is deliberately absent because this job never reads the repository.
